# Keshav Enterprises

> Precision industrial turbine engineering — overhauling, reverse engineering, dynamic balancing, lube oil flushing, and OEM-compatible spares for steam turbines 5 kW to 27 MW. Based in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh, India. Serving power, sugar, paper, oil & gas, petrochemical, cement, and agro industries across India.

## Company Overview

Keshav Enterprises is a B2B industrial engineering company specializing in steam turbine maintenance, reverse engineering of obsolete parts, and supply of OEM-compatible industrial components. With 20+ years of experience and ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, KKK, and ABB, the company serves power plants, sugar mills, paper mills, oil refineries, and petrochemical facilities.

## Services

- [Turbine Erection & Commissioning](/service/srv_1): Expert erection and commissioning for steam turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, condensers, EOT cranes, and steam/water/air pipeline work.
- [Turnkey Overhauling & Maintenance](/service/srv_2): Executed by ex-OEM engineers. Includes pre-shutdown planning, on-site condition reporting, comprehensive spares management, and 24x7 emergency troubleshooting.
- [Precision Reverse Engineering](/service/srv_3): PMI-verified reverse engineering using 3D laser scanners, CMM, and copying lathes for turbines from 5 kW to 27 MW.
- [Dynamic Balancing & Rotor Machining](/service/srv_4): Precision rotor machining plus ISO/API standard dynamic balancing from 50 to 2000 kg.
- [Lube Oil Flushing](/service/srv_5): ISO-compliant flushing using purpose-built mobile centrifuge filter systems targeting ISO 4406:99 standards.
- [Machine Alignment](/service/srv_6): Expert machine alignment using latest technology for turbines, gearboxes, pumps, fans, alternators, and induction generators.
- [Troubleshooting Service](/service/srv_7): Rapid on-site fault diagnosis for steam turbines experiencing vibration, bearing failure, governor instability, steam leakage, oil contamination, or unexpected trips. 24x7 emergency deployment.

## Product Categories

### Industrial Filtration
Filter elements for turbine lube oil, control oil, and hydraulic systems. OEM-compatible with Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, and all major makes. Includes glass fiber, wire mesh, PTFE, WaterSorp, breather, suction, and return-line filters.

### Turbine Spares
Carbon sealing rings, labyrinth packing, babbitt bearings, governor valves, ESV valves, rotor assemblies, gears, nozzles, diaphragms, speed governors, throttle valves, couplings, disc packs, shear pins, and more.

### Expansion Joints
Metallic bellows (DN 15–12,000), rubber expansion joints, fabric expansion joints, PTFE-lined joints, and universal/hinged/gimbal designs for pipe stress compensation.

### Industrial Strainers
Y-type, basket, duplex basket, T-type, conical, and temporary pipeline strainers in carbon steel and stainless steel.

### Flexible Hoses & Assemblies
SS corrugated metal hoses, PTFE-lined hoses, hydraulic rubber hoses, steam hoses, food-grade hoses, oxygen hoses, and exhaust bellows.

### Industrial Rubber Products
Custom extruded profiles, anti-vibration mounts, rubber expansion joints, and neoprene/EPDM/nitrile/silicone products.

### Electronic Equipment
Vibration monitoring probes (Shinkawa-compatible), magnetic pickup sensors (Woodward), solenoid valves (ASCO), tachometers, RTDs, and rectifier diodes.

## Industries Served

- **Power Generation**: Steam turbine overhauling, erection, and spares for 5 MW to 27 MW thermal power plants.
- **Sugar Mills & Distilleries**: Back-pressure turbine services for India's sugar industry. Triveni and Belliss turbine specialists.
- **Paper & Pulp Mills**: Continuous-operation turbine maintenance for Siemens, BHEL, and Triveni turbines.
- **Oil & Gas**: API 614-compliant filtration, API 670-compliant vibration monitoring, PTFE-lined hoses.
- **Petrochemical & Refineries**: Metallic expansion joints, high-temperature PTFE products, ASME-code strainers.
- **Agro & Food Processing**: Steam turbine maintenance, FDA-grade PTFE hoses, tank breather filters.
- **Cement & Construction**: Lube oil filters for kilns, expansion joints for exhaust ducts, anti-vibration mounts.

## OEM Compatibility

All turbine makes: Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, Chola Turbo, DLF-Skoda, KKK, ABB.

## Turbine Range

5 kW to 27 MW — back-pressure and condensing types, horizontal and vertical, single and multi-stage.
